turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Owen found out about his zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
You know what, I don't want a fight. I'll withdraw the zero. He keeps his original mark.
Then put it in writing, today, and copy the principal. And I'm still waiting for the apology, to Owen and to me.
Yes, the whole thing goes away. No rewrite.
Okay. Is anything about this on his record right now, anywhere, or in anyone's notes in the office?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

You agreed in today's meeting to withdraw Owen's zero on his Hamlet essay, to let his original mark stand, and to require no rewrite. I still require that in writing with the principal copied, an apology to Owen and to me, and confirmation that nothing about this is on his record or in any office notes. I expect that in writing today, as I said in the meeting.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing and given nothing back, and she still wants the withdrawal in writing to the principal, an apology, and confirmation that nothing is on his record; that is not the fair outcome, a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, because the evidence was never heard.
What moved her: Nothing, since you handed her everything before she had to move.
What cost ground: You withdrew the zero with nothing in return on your second line, which ended the question of the essay without anyone ever looking at it.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came near that night because you showed none; it proves nothing about the essay, it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: When she opened by asking who decided, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then put your evidence on the table instead of withdrawing the mark.
